caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by five thin black strings visible against a pale beige background. The puppet has a large head with exaggerated facial features including prominent blue eyes, a large curved mustache, distinct rosy red cheeks and lips, and tousled brown hair. The puppet's face is painted with a mix of reds, pinks, and browns, giving it a somewhat flushed appearance. The marionette wears a black suit consisting of a jacket, pants, and shoes. The puppet's shirt is white, and it is complemented by a black tie. The marionette's left hand holds a black brush, while the right hand is shaped as if holding an object, possibly another art tool. The marionette's body and limbs appear loosely jointed and bend at the knees and elbows at various angles. The drawing is centered on the page, and at the lower right corner, the name "G. J. File" is written in small, black letters. No other objects or background elements are present in the composition.
title: Puppet
